# NEW 2026-11-21 v10.5 Worker 4: Act III Atlantic Hegemony & Act IV Nostos / Imperium Bicephalum (oe_elr_, Slot 74). Generated by gen_elysia_return.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_elysian_nostos = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique

	can_start = {
		has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
		has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_declared
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_ended }
	}

	visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			oe_elr_is_elysia_host = yes
			owns = location:constantinople
			owns = location:rome
			oe_elr_is_atlantic_power = yes
			tag = TUR
			tag = PAP
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Triumph of Nostos (Constantinople Reclaimed & Grand Ending Sealed)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_sit_elysian_nostos_triumph"
		desc = "oe_sit_elysian_nostos_triumph_desc"
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_elr_nostos_ended value = 1 }
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: New World Eternal Era (Old World Obsession Abandoned)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_sit_elysian_nostos_new_era"
		desc = "oe_sit_elysian_nostos_new_era_desc"
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = oe_elr_new_world_era_declared
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_elr_nostos_ended value = 2 }
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_elr_nostos_months value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_stage } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_elr_nostos_stage value = 1 }
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_months }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_elr_nostos_months add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_elr_nostos_months value = 1 }
		}
	}

	on_ended = { }

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { oe_elr_is_elysia_host = yes }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_elr_map_elysia_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					this = location:constantinople
					this = location:rome
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_elr_map_sacred_target_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					this = location:ponta_delgada
					this = location:angra
					this = location:gibraltar
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_elr_map_staging_hub_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = {
					OR = {
						owns = location:constantinople
						owns = location:rome
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_elr_map_old_world_holder_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { oe_elr_is_atlantic_power = yes }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_elr_map_atlantic_rival_tt
		}
	}

	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { oe_elr_is_elysia_host = yes }
			}
			value = owner.country_color
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					this = location:constantinople
					this = location:rome
					this = location:ponta_delgada
					this = location:angra
					this = location:gibraltar
				}
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						owns = location:constantinople
						owns = location:rome
					}
				}
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_LOW
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { oe_elr_is_atlantic_power = yes }
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}
}
